# pve_node_hardware (Data Source)

Passthrough inventory of a node: PCI devices, USB devices, and (for one PCI device) mediated device profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node_hardware" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `pci_class_blacklist` (String) A list of blacklisted PCI classes, which will not be returned. Following are filtered by default: Memory Controller (05), Bridge (06) and Processor (0b). (default: 05;06;0b)
- `pci_id_or_mapping` (String) Path parameter "pci-id-or-mapping".
- `verbose` (Boolean) If disabled, does only print the PCI IDs. Otherwise, additional information like vendor and device will be returned. (default: 1)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<pci_id_or_mapping>.
- `mdev` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/hardware/pci/{pci-id-or-mapping}/mdev. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mdev))
- `overview` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/hardware. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--overview))
- `pci` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/hardware/pci. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pci))
- `pci_detail` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/hardware/pci/{pci-id-or-mapping}. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pci_detail))
- `usb` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/hardware/usb. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usb))

<a id="nestedatt--mdev"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mdev`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number) The number of still available instances of this type.
- `description` (String) Additional description of the type.
- `name` (String) A human readable name for the type.
- `type` (String) The name of the mdev type.


<a id="nestedatt--overview"></a>
### Nested Schema for `overview`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--pci"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pci`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) The PCI ID.
- `class` (String) The PCI Class of the device.
- `device` (String) The Device ID.
- `device_name` (String)
- `iommugroup` (Number) The IOMMU group in which the device is in. If no IOMMU group is detected, it is set to -1.
- `mdev` (Boolean) If set, marks that the device is capable of creating mediated devices.
- `subsystem_device` (String) The Subsystem Device ID.
- `subsystem_device_name` (String)
- `subsystem_vendor` (String) The Subsystem Vendor ID.
- `subsystem_vendor_name` (String)
- `vendor` (String) The Vendor ID.
- `vendor_name` (String)
